  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Female Operations Manager (Hospitality)",
  "description": "The Borough Lagos - Nestled in the heart of Lagos, our boutique hotel offers unparalleled luxury and service. Whether you&rsquo;re in Lagos working, relocating or traveling with your family, our boutique hotel will delight you with plush amenities with upscale d&eacute;cor. The Borough Lagos is already the trusted choice for the world&rsquo;s leading corporations, international organizations, and discerning private clients who want to relax in the stylish comfort and feel of their own home while on a long or short stay in the Lagos area.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Female Operations Manager (Hospitality)

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos&nbsp;

Job Summary


	The Operations Manager will oversee the day-to-day operations of Youtopia Beauty, ensuring seamless coordination across retail operations, inventory management, supply chain, sales support, logistics, and customer experience.
	The role is responsible for driving operational efficiency, maintaining stock accuracy, improving processes, and supporting business growth while ensuring excellent service delivery across all channels.
	The Operations Manager will work closely with the Managing Director to execute business strategies and achieve operational goals.


Responsibilities


	Oversee the day-to-day operations of the business, ensuring efficiency across retail, warehouse, and administrative functions.
	Manage inventory by monitoring stock levels, conducting stock counts, investigating discrepancies, and maintaining accurate records.
	Coordinate procurement, supplier relationships, and stock replenishment to ensure product availability.
	Supervise order fulfilment, logistics, and deliveries to ensure timely and accurate customer order processing.
	Monitor sales performance and identify operational improvements to support revenue growth.
	Develop, implement, and maintain operational policies, processes, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
	Prepare operational, inventory, and performance reports for the Managing Director.
	Lead, coach, and manage the operations and retail teams to ensure high performance and accountability.
	Collaborate with sales, marketing, finance, and customer service teams to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
	Identify opportunities for process improvements, cost savings, and operational excellence.
	Ensure compliance with company policies, health and safety standards, and operational best practices.
	Support the Managing Director with strategic initiatives and other operational projects as required.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 4 years of experience in an operations management role within the beauty, cosmetics, skincare, fashion, retail, or FMCG industry.
	Strong understanding of retail operations, inventory management, supply chain, procurement, and logistics.
	Proven experience managing teams and driving operational performance.
	Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
	Ability to analyse sales and inventory data to support business decisions.

	Production optimization under constraints
	Decision-making in high-uncertainty environments

	Field-intensive role across multiple OML 30 locations.


High exposure to:


	Security risks
	Swamp and difficult terrains
	On-call availability for emergency response (24/7 situations).


Role Context (OML 30 Reality):


	Export pipeline disruptions directly impact production revenue.
	High incidence of sabotage requires constant vigilance.
	Aging infrastructure demands proactive integrity management.
	Strong community relations are essential for uninterrupted operations.


Note


	No relocation support is available for this position.
	By submitting an application, candidates confirm that they are based in the advertised work location or will relocate at their own expense if selected.
